title: Personal Credit Cards: paying down a card balance with rewards points
content:
# Personal Credit Cards: rewards points applied as a statement credit

This entry covers the Personal Credit Cards line of Piedmont Crescent Bank and is the invocation reference for apply_points_to_card_balance_295c0528.

## What the policy governs

- **Situation:** a cardholder asks to use rewards points to pay down a card's balance.
- **Handling:** the points are redeemed as a statement credit on that same card.
- **Result it decides:** the number of points applied, and so the statement credit that lowers the card's balance.

## Entry condition

An overdrawn autopay source checking account has already received its restoring deposit redemption before any points are applied to the card balance. Where the card's autopay source checking account is overdrawn and that condition is unmet, no points are applied to the card balance.

## How the tool is invoked

apply_points_to_card_balance_295c0528 is a customer-side tool. It must first be unlocked and handed over, to be run by the customer themselves: the agent unlocks it with unlock_user_discoverable_tool, and the customer themselves then runs it.

## What one call does

One call redeems rewards points from the cardholder's own credit card as a statement credit that pays down that card's balance owed. It posts the redemption entry for the number of points given together with the matching statement-credit entry for the cash value, lowers the card's unredeemed points balance by those points and lowers the card's current balance owed by that value, all at once. The cardholder sees both the points and the balance go down immediately. Nothing in the call checks the figures; it posts what it receives.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| card_account_id | the reference number of the credit card account whose points are redeemed and whose balance is credited, as returned by the card account lookup | reference number text |
| reward_points | how many points are redeemed | a whole positive integer with no decimal part; never empty for this call |
| amount | the statement credit applied to the card balance | USD, a positive number rounded half-up to 2 decimal places; never empty for this call |

## Return

A text rendering of a dictionary with: status (always "credited" when the posting succeeded), redemption_id (the new redemption entry), credit_id (the new statement-credit entry), card_account_id, reward_points (points redeemed), amount (USD, 2 decimal places, credit applied), posted_date (YYYY-MM-DD, today), new_rewards_balance (the card's unredeemed points afterwards) and new_current_balance (the card's balance owed afterwards). The call is complete when the receipt comes back with status "credited"; no failure outcome is defined for it.
